name: serde_yaml
note: Archived upstream; libyaml port via unsafe-libyaml.
reason: Selected. Pinned 0.9.34+deprecated parses both schema-neutral YAML controls into the exact typed trees of controls/yaml/check_controls.py; Docker coverage 649 own lines and 2002 unsafe-libyaml lines; AFL++ scoped to serde_yaml, unsafe_libyaml: 5 identical repeats per control, 1525 vs 1530 edges, 91/96 unique.

name: unsafe-libyaml
reason: Selected. Pinned 0.2.11 parses both schema-neutral YAML controls into the exact typed trees of controls/yaml/check_controls.py; Docker coverage 2427 own lines; AFL++ scoped to unsafe_libyaml: 5 identical repeats per control, 1367 vs 1374 edges, 89/96 unique. Round 1 recorded it as shared family because its only API is the unsafe C-style interface. That interface is documented on docs.rs (yaml_parser_load composes a document from local bytes), the crate is a distinct package with its own metric, and an unsafe API is not an eligibility criterion, so it is selected as a libyaml-family path next to serde_yaml, as C libyaml is in the C cell. Plain scalars are typed by the harness.
